capabilities: Import HWP, HWPX, PDF, DOCX and XLSX files as Markdown notes
Export notes to HWPX, DOCX, HTML and PDF
Fill HWPX forms from note properties
Compare two document versions into a change table
Manage HWPX templates with document styles and fonts
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.8.9 or newer; scanned PDFs are not OCRed and password-protected PDFs cannot be imported; official-document notation checks are Korean-only.
motivation: Keep the source of knowledge in portable Markdown and produce HWPX, DOCX, HTML or PDF only when an institution requires it.
problem: Korean institutions require HWP/HWPX documents while Obsidian notes are Markdown, so content has to be retyped or converted by hand.

relations.evidence: Kordoc 4.25.0 built in: imports, generates, validates, compares, and fills documents without external setup.
the project that powered HanMark's earlier HWPX workflow
Pandoc — optional advanced DOCX conversion only; DOCX works without it.
be sent to the active CMDS Eagle cloud provider
generated styles expose real font names and paragraph properties in Hancom Office's toolbar

summary: Desktop plugin that imports HWP, HWPX, PDF, DOCX and XLSX files as Markdown notes and exports notes to HWPX, DOCX, HTML and PDF.
